island.protest2: Stop, stop! I'm a robot, not a button
island.emptyChat: Ask me anything. I can look at your screen, read your files and turn them into PDFs.
error.missingKey: The {detail} API key is missing. Add it in Settings → Artificial intelligence.
error.invalidKey: The {detail} API key isn't valid. Check it in Settings.
error.rateLimited: You've hit the {detail} usage limit. Wait a moment and try again.
error.network: Can't reach the AI service. Check your internet connection.
error.ollamaOffline: Ollama isn't responding. Open it and try again.
error.model: That model isn't available ({detail}). Pick another one in Settings.
error.refused: The model declined to answer this.
error.keyring: I couldn't use the system keychain.
island.defaultQuestion: What do you see on my screen? Can you help me with what I'm doing?
error.blocked: I won't look at the screen: a protected app is visible ({detail}).
error.screenPermission: I need Screen Recording permission. Turn it on for Tico in System Settings and reopen it.
settings.title: Tico settings
settings.followCursor: Appear on the monitor where the mouse is
settings.followCursorHint: If off, it always appears on the main monitor.
settings.hideOnFullscreen: Don't appear over full-screen apps (games, video)
settings.apiKeyHint: The key is stored in your system keychain, never in a file. You only pay for what you use on your provider account.
settings.ollamaHint: Install Ollama and download a vision model, for example: ollama pull gemma3
settings.captureMode.screen: The screen where the mouse is
settings.captureConfirm: Show me the thumbnail before sending
settings.blockedAppsHint: One per line. If any is on screen (in the app name or the window title), Tico won't capture anything.
settings.shortcutHint: Click and press the new combination (with Ctrl/⌘, Alt or Shift). Esc cancels.
settings.privacy: No telemetry and no accounts. Screenshots and the conversation only live in memory while Tico is open.
island.role.tico: Your all-round assistant: ask me anything.
island.role.code: I help you write and fix code.
island.role.write: I polish your texts and emails.
island.role.teach: I explain anything step by step.
island.dropHint: I'll read them, summarise them or turn them into PDF
island.filesActions: What should I do with these {count} files?
island.prompt.summary: Summarise the important points of this file.
island.noRecent: The PDFs I make for you will show up here.
island.lookingForDoc: Looking for the document you have open…
island.pickDocument: I can't see any open Word document: choose the file you want as a PDF.
island.notice.noVision: This model can't see images: I used the text read from the screen.
island.notice.modelChanged: The chosen model no longer exists: I switched to {detail}.
island.notice.retrying: The service is busy; trying again ({detail})…
error.noCredit: Your {detail} account has no credit. Add some on their website or use a free AI (Gemini, Groq or Ollama).
error.overloaded: {detail} is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
error.timeout: {detail} took too long to answer. Try again.
error.noVision: This model can't see images. Pick one with vision or turn on OCR in Settings.
error.tooLarge: It's too big for {detail}. Try something shorter.
error.missingUrl: The custom service address is missing (Settings → Artificial intelligence).
error.noDocument: I can't find any open document.
settings.ticosHint: Make a Tico for each task: each one has its own look, its own way of answering and, if you like, its own AI. Each keeps its own conversation.
settings.instructionsHint: Instructions for the AI: its role, tone, language…
settings.ticoModelHint: Empty: the general model for that AI.
settings.seasonal: Seasonal outfits (Christmas, Halloween) when it isn't wearing anything
settings.keyLooksLike: This key looks like a {provider} key.
settings.lmstudioHint: Open LM Studio, download a model and start the local server (Developer → Start server).
settings.customHint: Any OpenAI-compatible service, for example https://my-server/v1. The key is optional.
settings.demoHint: Sample answers to try Tico without a key or internet.
settings.freeTip: No key? Gemini, Groq and OpenRouter have free options, and Ollama or LM Studio run on your computer for free.
settings.autoCapture: Look at the screen by itself when I ask (“what's on my screen?”)
settings.ocr: Read the text on the screen (system OCR)
settings.ocrHint: This way it reads even small print and also works with models that can't see images. It all happens on your computer.
settings.pdfHint: To make PDFs I use Word, Excel or PowerPoint (Windows), Pages, Numbers or Keynote (Mac) or LibreOffice if you have them; otherwise I do it myself. Just ask: “turn this Word into a PDF”.
